name: Prediction of Failure
levelText: arcanist 8, occultist 6, psychic 8, sorcerer 8, witch 8, wizard 8
description: You wrack the target’s body and mind with the anguish and suffering of every bitter failure it will ever experience, rendering it permanently shaken and sickened. A successful Will save reduces the duration to 1 round per level. If the target is a spellcaster, failing this saving throw means it also gains a random minor spellblight (see Ultimate Magic).
